label: GO: choosing a2 right after a rewarded (common) S2 trial, mid-episode (trials ~10-60)
explanation: Fires only at GO (100% of mass), only when the previous trial was rewarded (prev_reward==1, 100% of mass) and the agent picks a2 (model_act==2 / action==2, 100% of mass; the choice is the agent own upcoming choice, which it computes, so it is not a future random outcome; model_act gives the same F1). The previous trial was almost always a common a2->S2 trial (prev_common==0 holds only 0.6% of mass); prev_state != 1 keeps the first trial of each window, where prev_state is unknown. Strong dependence on episode time: active on trials 10-59 (95% of mass, peaking at trials 30-39) and essentially silent after trial 60. This is a drift in the hidden state over the episode, which the value bin 7.73-8.10 also tracks. Magnitude (checked): largest on the first rewarded a2 trial after an unrewarded one, then falls off over consecutive rewards (about 1.0 -> 0.4 -> 0.15 -> 0.07) and is zero in long rewarded streaks. Restricting to at most 2-3 rewards in a row keeps about 91-94% of mass but does not raise F1. Never fires at D1/D2, after unrewarded trials, or when choosing a1. Precision stays about 0.6 because many stay-a2-after-reward GO steps in the same window, deep in long reward streaks, are silent. Dev F1 0.75, mass recall 0.96.
